name: Priest of the Destroyer
originalText:
### Priest of the Destroyer

- **Path Type:** Novice
- **Source:** Heirs of Eremea
- **Source Page:** 8
- **PDF Page:** 8

```text
Priest of the Destroyer (Novice)
As close as the Cult of the Destroyer works with the
Heirs of Eremea, the two organizations remain distinct.
Dissatisfaction with what they see as a weak and feckless
regent, anger at the corruption in the Cult of the New God
has seen people flock to join the resurgent religion. The
congregation has its largest following among the humans of
Old Edene, but it’s orthodoxy and nationalistic tendencies
has seen converts from among sympathizers beyond the
nation’s borders.

The priesthood welcomes any
member of Edene extraction
into their ranks and pushes
them through a short period
of training and initiation. The
religion’s infancy and its hastily
assembled holy book mean there’s
little to learn for now. After a period
of three weeks, the presiding priest
performs a ceremony to ordain the acolytes.
Understand, though, that few of these elevated
individuals have any ability to perform miracles.
Most deliver sermons, perform administrative
duties, and take up arms as necessary.

Priests don forest green robes and pointed hoods
that cover all but their eyes. They wear golden cords
with tassels around their waists and from them hang
the scabbards for their curved ceremonial knives and
slender chains on which depend the gold symbol of
Corumbrax, the Divided One.

The priests work to drive off all other religions out of
Old Edene. Once they complete this task, they intend to
establish a theocratic government in which the cult leader
rules the land in the name of the Divided One. They
promote hostile action against the Cult of the New God
while quietly erasing the shrines and temples of the Old
Faith.

Individual priests spread the news of the Destroyer by
urging people to profess their belief in the Divided One as
the mortal incarnation of the god, so that they will escape
the pain and horror of the angry Destroyer. Aside from
their intolerance of other religion, the Corumbraxians
preach peace, cooperation, and good, wholesome living.

Traditions often associated with the Destroyer include
Battle, Destruction, and Order (see Demon Lord’s Companion
2 and Occult Philosophy).

Level 1 Priest of the Destroyer
Attributes: Increase two attribute scores by 1 each.
Characteristics: Health +4, Power +1
Languages and Professions: You either read one language
you can speak or add a language to the list of languages
you can speak. Also, add one Religious profession to
your list of professions.
Magic: You discover the Destruction, Earth, or Order
tradition. Then, choose one of the following benefits.
• You discover the other two traditions.
• You discover one of the other traditions and learn one
spell.
• You learn two spells.
Destructive Recovery: You can use an action to heal
damage equal to your healing rate. Then, target one
creature other than you that is within short range. The
target makes a Strength challenge roll. On a failure, the
target takes damage equal to your healing rate. Once
you use this talent, you must complete a rest before you
can use it again. At level 8, you can use this talent twice
before needing to rest.

Level 2 Priest of the Destroyer
Characteristics: Health +4
Magic: Choose one of the following benefits.
• You discover any two of the following traditions:
Destruction, Earth, or Order.
• You discover one of the following traditions:
Destruction, Earth, or Order. Then, you learn one spell.
• You learn two spells.
Ruinous Prayer: When you or a creature within short
range of you makes an attack roll, you can use a
triggered action to grant 1 boon on the triggering roll. If
the result of the roll is 20 or higher, the target takes 1d6
extra damage.

Level 5 Priest of the Destroyer
Characteristics: Health +4, Power
Magic: You learn one spell.
Ruinous Strike: When you use Ruinous Prayer, target
one creature you can see within short range. The target
makes a Strength challenge roll. On a failure the target
takes 2d6 damage. Once you use this talent, you must
wait until after the end of your next turn before you can
use it again.

Level 8 Priest of the Destroyer
Characteristics: Health +4
Magic: You learn one spell.
Rising Ruin: Each time you deal damage to a creature or
object with a Health score of 10 or higher, roll a d6. On a
6, you gain a Ruin token up to a maximum equal to your
level. On a 1, you become impaired until the end of your
next turn. You retain Ruin tokens until you spend them
or you complete a rest.
At the start of your turn, you can spend 1 Ruin token.
The next time you deal damage before the start of your
next turn, you deal 2d6 extra damage.
```
